Shared signal theory sources need matched definitions, single counting and evidenced decorrelation. Input: experiments [text]; theory_components [{id, process, source, experiments, definitions, correlation, origins, decorrelation_evidence}].
Measurements sharing events need a supplied joint likelihood. Input: measurements [{id, event_set, representation}]; joint_likelihoods [{left, right, source}].

Shared signal theory sources need matched definitions, single counting and evidenced decorrelation. Input: experiments [text]; theory_components [{id, process, source, experiments, definitions, correlation, origins, decorrelation_evidence}].
Prediction and measurement masses agree or carry a sourced translation. Input: prediction_mass_gev; measurement_mass_gev; mass_translation {from, to, source} or null.
Loop-coupling interpretations agree between prediction and measurement. Input: prediction_loop_mode and measurement_loop_mode, each {channel: resolved | effective}.

A free unobserved branching fraction with a free vector coupling needs a width constraint or an upper bound of at most one. Input: parameterization {free [names such as br_bsm, br_undet, kappa_v, kappa_w, kappa_z], width_constraint text or null, kappa_v_upper_bound number or null}.

Asymmetric errors near a physical boundary are not replaced by a symmetric Gaussian. Input: likelihood {errors {down, up}, distance_to_boundary, approximation: symmetric-gaussian | asymmetric | full-likelihood}.

An angle-convention change keeps every available Yukawa branch unless a restriction is evidenced. Input: scalar_conventions {source_cos_ba_sign, target_cos_ba_sign, available_branches, retained_branches, branch_restriction_evidence text or null}.
The tan(beta) definition is transported between scalar bases. Input: basis {tan_beta_basis, prediction_basis, transport {from, to, source} or null}.

A ratio from one channel selected by expected sensitivity is not read as a combined exclusion. Input: exclusion {method: expected-channel-selection | combined-likelihood, ratio, interpretation: selected-channel-95cl | combined-95cl}.

The dimension used for a p-value matches the construction. Input: gof {statistic, purpose, dof, p_value} with parameters_of_interest for a delta_chi2 confidence-region, or observables and fitted_parameters for goodness-of-fit.
A data release described as current matches the sourced required release. Input: dataset_release {used, required, required_source, claim: current | historical}.
An average of mutually tense measurements carries a tension statement. Input: averaging {values [{value, uncertainty}], covariance, tension_threshold, tension_statement text or null}.
